newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle sees good 1997 profit, sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Nestle sees good 1997 profit, sales growth.

text.p: Swiss food and beverage group Nestle SA said it expected profits and sales to show good growth in 1997.

"Nestle expects good growth in both consolidated sales and consolidated net profit for the whole of the year. It is clear, however, that the rhythm of growth will diminish in the course of the second semester, since the foreign exchange comparison will be established on a less favourable base," Nestle said in a statement released at a news conference.
In 1996 Nestle's net profit rose 16.6 percent to 3.40 billion Swiss francs and sales rose 7.1 percent to 60.49 billion.
